claims.text: Periodicity-aware convolutional models are data-efficient on ETTh1, Weather.
TimesNet is best characterised as 2D-convolutional periodicity-aware model.

evidence.description: TimesNet outperforms transformer baselines when trained on 5% of the data on ETTh1.

limitations.text: Reported gains use a single held-out split; results across seeds vary by more than the headline MSE difference.
Computational cost is reported for a single input length; scaling behaviour is not measured.

future_work.text: Studying performance under explicit train/test distribution shift.
Pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer.
